resources.string: Health Tip. Stay Hydrated. Drink enough water throughout the day to stay healthy.
Health Tip. Eat a Balanced Diet. Include fruits, vegetables, whole grains and lean proteins.
Health Tip. Stay Physically Active. Do at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise most days of the week.
Health Tip. Get Quality Sleep. Aim for 7–9 hours of restful sleep each night for better health.
Health Tip. Keep Good Hand Hygiene. Wash your hands regularly with soap and water to prevent infections.
